source_issues.detail: Complexity accounting is inconsistent. Intro gives O(N²) total, then claims O(N²) to O(N) per step; both decoder implementations call single-query attention over all cached keys and increment ops by prefix length, so both total N(N+1)/2 attention dot products, not 5050 versus 100. main() uses N=10, not the claimed 100. Claims retained without correction.
7B cache arithmetic states 32 heads but omits that factor: 512 bytes is per head per token per layer; 16 KB/token and 512 MB/32K are therefore not whole-model cache sizes. Preserved.

70B 32K estimate is approximately 10.7 decimal GB or 10 GiB, not an exact 10.4 GB; at 128K cache is approximately 42.95 GB/40 GiB. With the stated 80 layers, 64 MHA heads, d_head=128 and fp16 at 32K, 32 GB is not the implied value. Decimal/binary units and the cited hardware capacity are mixed. Preserved.
Standard softmax score output is N×N, whereas source says N×d softmax output. Preserved.
Exact mathematical attention is not a guarantee of bit-identical floating-point output. Source itself qualifies reassociation and code prints numerical error. Preserved.

Attribution of both KV caching and FlashAttention to Dao et al.; universal adoption, hardware bandwidth/round-trip simplifications, fixed speedups, Flash 4 mid-2026 feature status, no-quality-loss statement, and fragmentation elimination are broad or time-sensitive source claims. No live factual verification was attempted under frozen-source scope; these claims are retained, not endorsed.
Niche but free does not identify which cost is free. Translation keeps 免费 without expanding it to licensing, absence of compute, or no extra model; ambiguity remains in source.
